fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) achieved record profitability in the September quarter, with revenue increasing 61% to $4.23 billion, non-GAAP EPS of $7.68, and record free cash flow of $1.48 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance of $4.8 billion (±$100 million), non-GAAP EPS of $9.20 (±20 cents), with expectations for increased exabyte shipments and cost savings through HAMR technology advancement and high-capacity Mozaic drives.
